verdict.rationale: Brevo's developer docs describe API-driven transactional email for order confirmations, password resets and other automated sends. They add batch personalization, idempotency keys and a sandbox mode, and document magic links sent via SMTP for Supabase Auth. All of this sits on a single platform that also runs marketing campaigns. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of transactional sending in practice, and explicit docs showing marketing campaign sends through the same API.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send one-to-one transactional email — receipts, magic links, notifications — through the same platform's API alongside marketing sends

citations.quote: Send order confirmations, password resets, and other automated emails to your users.
